purpose: Test whether the V168 immutable CPU guard should activate only for at least three simultaneously collectable heavy incomplete-parent terminal players, preserving exact V159 behavior for zero, one, or two such players while protecting E20 from multiway speculative terminal contention.

causal_diagnosis.interpretation: V169's node-count threshold was dimensionally wrong for an instantaneous collectable-player signal and self-suppressing because inactive V159 admission drains heavy terminals before they accumulate. Three simultaneous heavy terminals is the smallest preregisterable multiplicity that exercises E20 early while leaving both E09 and E18 on exact V159 behavior in the sealed result-blind traces.

single_mechanism_change_from_v169.precount: unchanged V169 current collectable terminal request-function count with an incomplete direct parent and immutable function CPU divided by mean node CPU strictly above one
single_mechanism_change_from_v169.activation_rule: activate the exact V168 CPU guard only when the current-window heavy terminal player count is strictly greater than two, i.e. at least three concurrent heavy players
single_mechanism_change_from_v169.inactive_rule: when the count is zero, one, or two, admit terminal players exactly as V159
single_mechanism_change_from_v169.contention_interpretation: a pair is tolerated; three or more simultaneous heavy dependency-bypassing terminal players constitute multiway contention
